checks.claim: A front-loading washer's final spin reaches about 1,200 revolutions per minute.
checks.why: Bosch, Samsung and LG front loaders list 1,200 rpm as their maximum spin; 1,200 to 1,400 is the common range.

sources.title: Bosch front loader WAN24124AU (max spin 1200 rpm)

checks.claim: A washer's perforated inner drum sits inside a sealed outer tub that holds the water.
checks.why: The inner drum is perforated so water passes in and out; the outer tub around it holds the water and connects to the drain.

sources.title: The anatomy of a washing machine (Ariel)

checks.claim: Front-loading washers have a drain pump filter that catches coins, socks and small objects before they reach the pump.
checks.why: Most front loaders have a drain pump filter (coin trap) behind a small door at the bottom front that catches coins, buttons and small socks before the pump.

sources.title: Finding and Cleaning a Washing Machine Filter (Sears)
Samsung: clean the debris filter in a front loader
